doc: Value-function pieces and step certificates for the 2p^b energy chain (x = 1/p, mu = x^n). Pieces of residue k = n mod 4: n g + const + const_xn mu + (s + s_xn mu) s + (t + t_xn mu) t, g = 2(1-x)/(1+x^2). A step certificate says: for n >= n0, n = k mod 4, the candidate 2(1-x) d_coord(corner, u) + piece_k(x u + (1-x) corner) - g is at most sum_l weights[l] piece_{k+1,l}(u). Untrusted search output: every certificate is re-checked in Lean.
doc_base: Base certificates (n = 1): 2(1-x) d_coord(corner, u) + V_0(x u + (1-x) corner) - g <= sum_l weights[l] piece_{1,l}(u) at mu = x, with V_0 pieces [2 s, 2 t].
